desc: Photo-style: two blonde girls in black stand against red wall, cigarettes in hand, dirt-smudged legs.
Two monochrome blonde girls smoking against vivid red; leather jacket and vest, drifting smoke.
Comic-style duo striding forward: white-haired girl in leather glares, smaller dark-haired girl beside her, smoke curling.
Blonde in studded leather holds cigarette low; bruised dark-haired girl in shorts walks behind her.
Tall white-haired girl smokes while a blue-eyed dark-haired girl in patch jacket watches her.
Blonde with cigarette in lips and studded jacket walks beside somber curly-haired girl in black tee.
Girl in shiny leather jacket holds cigarette toward weary blonde companion in white jacket.
Near-duplicate of 021: leather-clad girl with cigarette leans toward tired blonde in white jacket.
Two blondes walking; leather-jacketed one clutches cigarette to chest, wide-eyed girl looks back fearfully.
White-haired girl with cigarette and choker strides beside freckled dark-haired girl in skull tee.
Small girl smoking in leather jacket walks a scarred path with taller sweating blonde companion.
Black-haired girl exhales smoke in two-tone leather jacket; bruised blonde in shorts walks alongside.
Dark-haired girl in leather and blonde in graphic tee walk together, cigarette held low, ink splatter.
Bob-cut girl smoking in camo leather nearly holds hands with stern blonde carrying a shoulder bag.
